--- ## Walkthrough This PR updates Go toolchain and dependencies to 1.25.10, expands container runtime filesystem utilities with verification, adds node-side udevadm retry loops for device discovery with configurable timing, refactors controller volume and snapshot parameter handling to use resource group scoping, hardens Kubernetes manifests by replacing templated configmap values with fixed settings, and updates deployment labels and documentation. ## Changes **Build Toolchain and Runtime Environment** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Go version and dependency upgrades**
`Dockerfile.builder`, `Makefile`, `go.mod`|Go bumped to 1.25.10; IBM dependencies `ibmcloud-volume-interface` and `ibmcloud-volume-vpc` advance by one release; indirect dependencies including OpenTelemetry, crypto/net, and compression libraries are updated.| |**Build output paths and secrets baseline**
`Makefile`, `Dockerfile.openshift`, `scripts/build-bin.sh`, `.secrets.baseline`|Build targets output binaries to `${GOPATH}/bin` instead of workspace bin/; shell script error handling is enabled; secrets baseline detectors and findings are refreshed.| |**Docker runtime filesystem and device tools**
`Dockerfile`|Runtime image adds udev, e2fsprogs, xfsprogs, util-linux mount tooling, and nfs-common; a build-time verification step ensures critical commands (udevadm, blkid, mount, mkfs, fsck, xfs utilities) are present.| **Controller Snapshot and Volume Handling** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Snapshot resource group derivation**
`pkg/ibmcsidriver/controller.go`|CreateSnapshot derives `resourceGroupID` from request parameters and CSI config, passes it into snapshot existence lookup, and sets it on snapshot creation parameters.| |**Volume parameter parsing and validation**
`pkg/ibmcsidriver/controller_helper.go`, `pkg/ibmcsidriver/controller_helper_test.go`|getVolumeParameters is refactored to validate StorageClass parameters (Throughput parsing, tag trimming/splitting, bounded ResourceGroup/EncryptionKey lengths, unsupported FsType rejection, profile validation); overrideParams centralizes secret overrides with resource group defaulting; new getResourceGroup helper selects resource group from snapshot parameters or cluster config; tests added for resource group behavior.| **Node Device Discovery and Staging** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Device path discovery with udevadm retry**
`pkg/ibmcsidriver/node_helper.go`|findDevicePathSource now validates inputs, executes udevadm trigger when device path is missing, and polls for device appearance using environment-configurable retry parameters (UDEVADM_MAX_RETRIES, UDEVADM_RETRY_INTERVAL); udevadmTrigger and new waitForDevicePath helper implement command execution and retry polling via mounter executor.| |**NodeStageVolume device path validation**
`pkg/ibmcsidriver/node.go`|NodeStageVolume adds a critical safety check: after resolving device source, it verifies existence via PathExists before proceeding to format/mount; logging is enhanced with mount options and contextual fields.| |**Device discovery and retry tests**
`pkg/ibmcsidriver/node_helper_test.go`|Expanded test suite with table-driven coverage: TestFindDevicePathSource, TestUdevadmTrigger (refactored to subtests), TestWaitForDevicePath, TestFindDevicePathSourceWithRetry, and TestWaitForDevicePathEnvironmentVariables validate device lookup, udevadm execution, retry timing, and environment-variable parsing.| |**Node operation tests with device mocking**
`pkg/ibmcsidriver/node_test.go`|TestNodePublishVolume, TestNodeStageVolume, and TestNodeExpandVolume set UDEVADM environment variables for deterministic testing and inject mocked udevadm actions; device-not-found test cases now expect codes.Internal; new TestCollectMountOptions and TestFSInfo tests validate mount option and filesystem info handling.| |**Node manifest udev configuration**
`deploy/kubernetes/driver/kubernetes/manifests/node-server.yaml`|Node-server.yaml DaemonSet wires UDEVADM_SETTLE_TIMEOUT, UDEVADM_MAX_RETRIES, and UDEVADM_RETRY_INTERVAL environment variables; all containers' CPU/memory limits/requests are switched from configmap templating to fixed string values.| **Deployment Manifests and Configuration** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Controller manifest fixed configuration**
`deploy/kubernetes/driver/kubernetes/manifests/controller-server.yaml`|All sidecars and main container CPU/memory resource limits/requests switch from configmap templating to fixed quantities; csi-attacher arguments (worker-threads, kube-api-qps, kube-api-burst) and iks-vpc-block-driver environment variables (retry attempts/intervals) become fixed numeric/string values.| |**Stage overlay restructuring and namespacing**
`deploy/kubernetes/driver/kubernetes/overlays/stage/controller-server-images.yaml`, `deploy/kubernetes/driver/kubernetes/overlays/stage/kustomization.yaml`, `deploy/kubernetes/driver/kubernetes/overlays/stage/node-server-images.yaml`|controller-server-images.yaml changes from StatefulSet to Deployment with explicit metadata name and kube-system namespace; kustomization.yaml transitions from `bases` to `resources` and restructures `patches` into structured path objects; node-server-images.yaml adds explicit kube-system namespace.| |**Documentation and labeling**
`README.md`, `scripts/apply-required-setup.sh`|README adds `ibm-cloud.kubernetes.io/vpc-instance-id` to required worker node labels; apply-required-setup.sh updates labeling to use `kubectl label node --overwrite` for each label and adds `ibm-cloud.kubernetes.io/machine-type=upi` label.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~70 minutes ## Suggested reviewers - RomanBednar --- > [!IMPORTANT] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. Inline comments: In `@Dockerfile.builder`: - Line 1: Replace the FROM golang:1.25.10 base image with a Red Hat UBI minimal or distroless image from catalog.redhat.com that complies with the container-hardening policy. After the base image declaration, add a USER directive to specify a non-root user for running the container, ensuring the builder image does not run as root as required by the coding guidelines. In `@pkg/ibmcsidriver/controller_helper_test.go`: - Around line 811-882: Add a new test case to the testCases slice in the TestGetResourceGroup function to cover the scenario where ResourceGroup contains leading and trailing whitespace around a valid value (e.g., " 123r2423 "). This test case should verify that the getResourceGroup function properly normalizes and trims the input, returning the clean value without the padding spaces. Set the description, snapShotParams with a padded ResourceGroup value, expectedRG to the trimmed result, and expectedStatus to true. In `@pkg/ibmcsidriver/controller_helper.go`: - Around line 174-181: The Throughput case in the validation logic accepts zero and negative values from strconv.ParseInt, but throughput should only accept positive integers as per strict input validation requirements at trust boundaries. After successfully parsing the value with strconv.ParseInt in the Throughput case (lines 174-181), add a validation check to ensure the parsed bandwidth value is greater than 0. If bandwidth is less than or equal to 0, set the error to indicate that throughput must be a positive integer. Apply the same validation fix to the duplicate throughput validation code at lines 338-345. - Around line 469-471: The code on line 469 validates that strings.TrimSpace(rg) is non-empty, but line 471 returns the untrimmed rg variable instead of the trimmed value. This allows resource group values with leading or trailing whitespace to propagate through the system. Fix this by returning strings.TrimSpace(rg) instead of rg on line 471 to ensure the normalized value is returned at the trust boundary. - Around line 290-314: The logging statements for ResourceGroup and Tag values are exposing sensitive secret-sourced metadata that should not be logged verbatim. For the Encrypted case at line 290, remove the zap.Any(ResourceGroup, value) parameter and log only that the override occurred without the actual value. Similarly, for the Tag case at line 312, remove the zap.Any(Tag, value) parameter and log only that tags are being appended without logging the raw tag values. Replace these with generic messages that confirm the action took place without exposing the customer/internal data contained in those values. In `@pkg/ibmcsidriver/node_helper.go`: - Around line 91-92: The device-path retry operations in waitForDevicePath, findDevicePathSource, and udevadmTrigger do not respect context cancellation, allowing work to continue after RPC deadlines or cancellations. Pass the context.Context parameter (ctx) to all three functions (waitForDevicePath at line 91-92, findDevicePathSource, and udevadmTrigger), then add ctx.Done() checks in the retry loops and sleep intervals at lines 241-270 to short-circuit and return early when the context is cancelled. This ensures the retry mechanisms properly respect caller-imposed timeouts and cancellation signals. - Around line 80-83: The code at line 81 parses the UDEVADM_RETRY_INTERVAL environment variable but does not validate that the resulting duration is positive. Add a check to ensure the parsed interval is greater than 0 before assigning it to retryInterval. Modify the condition on line 82 (the existing `err == nil` check) to also verify that `interval > 0` in order to reject zero or negative durations that could cause tight retry loops and excessive logging. In `@pkg/ibmcsidriver/node_test.go`: - Around line 288-290: The TestNodeStageVolume test sets UDEVADM_SLEEP_DURATION environment variable, but the retry logic no longer uses this variable and instead uses UDEVADM_MAX_RETRIES and UDEVADM_RETRY_INTERVAL. Replace the t.Setenv call for UDEVADM_SLEEP_DURATION with calls to set UDEVADM_MAX_RETRIES and UDEVADM_RETRY_INTERVAL to appropriate values (e.g., 1 retry with 0 interval) to prevent the default ~28 second wait in the "Device path not found" test case at line 298. In `@scripts/apply-required-setup.sh`: - Around line 10-19: The apply_labels() function executes multiple kubectl label commands without any error handling, which can result in a node being partially labeled if any command fails. Add error handling to the function by either using set -e at the beginning of the function to exit on first error, or by chaining the kubectl commands with && operators so that execution stops immediately if any single label command fails. This ensures the function either completes all labeling operations successfully or fails completely without leaving the node in an inconsistent state. - Around line 12-18: The kubectl label commands on lines 12-18 have unquoted positional parameters ($1, $2, $3, $4) which allow word splitting and globbing to occur, breaking label application when input contains spaces or special characters. Quote all positional parameters in all seven kubectl label command invocations: wrap $1, $2, $3, and $4 in double quotes (e.g., "$1", "$2", "$3", "$4") to preserve the intended values and satisfy Shellcheck SC2086 validation. --- Outside diff comments: In `@README.md`: - Around line 31-37: The required labels documentation in README.md is out of sync with the actual labels applied by the setup script. Add the missing label `ibm-cloud.kubernetes.io/machine-type=upi` to the list of required labels in the README.md documentation (in the section showing the code block with the other label strings) to match what is applied in line 18 of scripts/apply-required-setup.sh. This ensures the documentation accurately reflects all labels that will be applied and prevents manual labeling drift. ```
